text: Japan's October exports rose 20.5% YoY, including semiconductor equipment at 49.7%. Petroleum import value rose 60.5% despite a 0.7% volume decline. U.S. petroleum import volumes increased 738%, while Middle Eastern volumes declined 16.5%.

meta.note: Export growth is measured by value; petroleum sourcing changes are measured by volume.

text: Xi Jinping called for removing trade and investment barriers at APEC, outlining tariff reductions, foreign manufacturing access and regional coordination in AI and the digital economy. Planned reciprocal U.S.-China tariff reductions of $30 billion per side remain unimplemented.

meta.note: Expansion and alignment characterize declared policy positions rather than implemented measures.

text: Putin highlighted Russia's reduced dollar- and euro-denominated transactions amid U.S. sanctions, presented economic and technological opportunities to APEC members, and requested support for hosting APEC in 2035. He characterized EU industrial capacity as declining.

meta.note: Economic resilience and EU industrial decline are attributed claims rather than independently established conditions.

text: Trump arrived in Shenzhen for APEC, joining Xi Jinping and Vladimir Putin at the summit. Trilateral talks are scheduled for Nov. 19, alongside U.S.-China bilateral discussions. Existing trade restrictions and geopolitical disputes remain unresolved.

meta.note: Convergence denotes diplomatic co-location, not substantive policy agreement.

text: Target reported Q3 revenue of $27.07 billion, up 7.1% YoY, comparable sales growth of 5.6% and traffic growth of 5%. Net income rose from $689 million to $1.21 billion. Annual capex reached approximately $3.8 billion, with prices reduced on another 2,000 items during Q3.

meta.note: Full-year margin guidance includes a 1.1-percentage-point benefit from tariff refunds.
